24 from ..types.events import (

40 class _BidiAgentLoop:
41     """Agent loop.
42 
43     Attributes:
44         _agent: BidiAgent instance to loop.
45         _started: Flag if agent loop has started.
46         _task_pool: Track active async tasks created in loop.
47         _event_queue: Queue model and tool call events for receiver.
48         _invocation_state: Optional context to pass to tools during execution.
49             This allows passing custom data (user_id, session_id, database connections, etc.)
50             that tools can access via their invocation_state parameter.
51         _send_gate: Gate the sending of events to the model.
52             Blocks when agent is reseting the model connection after timeout.
53     """
54 
55     def __init__(self, agent: "BidiAgent") -> None:
56         """Initialize members of the agent loop.
57 
58         Note, before receiving events from the loop, the user must call `start`.
59 
60         Args:
61             agent: Bidirectional agent to loop over.
62         """
63         self._agent = agent
64         self._started = False
65         self._task_pool = _TaskPool()
66         self._event_queue: asyncio.Queue
67         self._invocation_state: dict[str, Any]
68 
69         self._send_gate = asyncio.Event()
70 
71     async def start(self, invocation_state: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
72         """Start the agent loop.
73 
74         The agent model is started as part of this call.
75 
76         Args:
77             invocation_state: Optional context to pass to tools during execution.
78                 This allows passing custom data (user_id, session_id, database connections, etc.)
79                 that tools can access via their invocation_state parameter.
80 
81         Raises:
82             RuntimeError: If loop already started.
83         """
84         if self._started:
85             raise RuntimeError("loop already started | call stop before starting again")
86 
87         logger.debug("agent loop starting")
88         await self._agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(BidiBeforeInvocationEvent(agent=self._agent))
89 
90         await self._agent.model.start(
91             system_prompt=self._agent.system_prompt,
92             tools=self._agent.tool_registry.get_all_tool_specs(),
93             messages=self._agent.messages,
94         )
95 
96         self._event_queue = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=1)
97 
98         self._task_pool = _TaskPool()
99         self._task_pool.create(self._run_model())
100 
101         self._invocation_state = invocation_state or {}
102         self._send_gate.set()
103         self._started = True
104 
105     async def stop(self) -> None:
106         """Stop the agent loop."""
107         logger.debug("agent loop stopping")
108 
109         self._started = False
110         self._send_gate.clear()
111         self._invocation_state = {}
112 
113         async def stop_tasks() -> None:
114             await self._task_pool.cancel()
115 
116         async def stop_model() -> None:
117             await self._agent.model.stop()
118 
119         try:
120             await stop_all(stop_tasks, stop_model)
121         finally:
122             await self._agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(BidiAfterInvocationEvent(agent=self._agent))
123 
124     async def send(self, event: BidiInputEvent | ToolResultEvent) -> None:
125         """Send model event.
126 
127         Additionally, add text input to messages array.
128 
129         Args:
130             event: User input event or tool result.
131 
132         Raises:
133             RuntimeError: If start has not been called.
134         """
135         if not self._started:
136             raise RuntimeError("loop not started | call start before sending")
137 
138         if not self._send_gate.is_set():
139             logger.debug("waiting for model send signal")
140             await self._send_gate.wait()
141 
142         if isinstance(event, BidiTextInputEvent):
143             message: Message = {"role": "user", "content": [{"text": event.text}]}
144             await self._agent._append_messages(message)
145 
146         await self._agent.model.send(event)
147 
148     async def receive(self) -> AsyncGenerator[BidiOutputEvent, None]:
149         """Receive model and tool call events.
150 
151         Returns:
152             Model and tool call events.
153 
154         Raises:
155             RuntimeError: If start has not been called.
156         """
157         if not self._started:
158             raise RuntimeError("loop not started | call start before receiving")
159 
160         while True:
161             event = await self._event_queue.get()
162             if isinstance(event, BidiModelTimeoutError):
163                 logger.debug("model timeout error received")
164                 yield BidiConnectionRestartEvent(event)
165                 await self._restart_connection(event)
166                 continue
167 
168             if isinstance(event, Exception):
169                 raise event
170 
171             # Check for graceful shutdown event
172             if isinstance(event, BidiConnectionCloseEvent) and event.reason == "user_request":
173                 yield event
174                 break
175 
176             yield event
177 
178     async def _restart_connection(self, timeout_error: BidiModelTimeoutError) -> None:
179         """Restart the model connection after timeout.
180 
181         Args:
182             timeout_error: Timeout error reported by the model.
183         """
184         logger.debug("reseting model connection")
185 
186         self._send_gate.clear()
187 
188         await self._agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(BidiBeforeConnectionRestartEvent(self._agent, timeout_error))
189 
190         restart_exception = None
191         try:
192             await self._agent.model.stop()
193             await self._agent.model.start(
194                 self._agent.system_prompt,
195                 self._agent.tool_registry.get_all_tool_specs(),
196                 self._agent.messages,
197                 **timeout_error.restart_config,
198             )
199             self._task_pool.create(self._run_model())
200         except Exception as exception:
201             restart_exception = exception
202         finally:
203             await self._agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(
204                 BidiAfterConnectionRestartEvent(self._agent, restart_exception)
205             )
206 
207         self._send_gate.set()
208 
209     async def _run_model(self) -> None:
210         """Task for running the model.
211 
212         Events are streamed through the event queue.
213         """
214         logger.debug("model task starting")
215 
216         try:
217             async for event in self._agent.model.receive():
218                 await self._event_queue.put(event)
219 
220                 if isinstance(event, BidiTranscriptStreamEvent):
221                     if event["is_final"]:
222                         message: Message = {"role": event["role"], "content": [{"text": event["text"]}]}
223                         await self._agent._append_messages(message)
224 
225                 elif isinstance(event, ToolUseStreamEvent):
226                     tool_use = event["current_tool_use"]
227                     self._task_pool.create(self._run_tool(tool_use))
228 
229                 elif isinstance(event, BidiInterruptionEvent):
230                     await self._agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(
231                         BidiInterruptionHookEvent(
232                             agent=self._agent,
233                             reason=event["reason"],
234                             interrupted_response_id=event.get("interrupted_response_id"),
235                         )
236                     )
237 
238         except Exception as error:
239             await self._event_queue.put(error)
240 
241     async def _run_tool(self, tool_use: ToolUse) -> None:
242         """Task for running tool requested by the model using the tool executor.
243 
244         Args:
245             tool_use: Tool use request from model.
246         """
247         logger.debug("tool_name=<%s> | tool execution starting", tool_use["name"])
248 
249         tool_results: list[ToolResult] = []
250 
251         invocation_state: dict[str, Any] = {
252             **self._invocation_state,
253             "agent": self._agent,
254             "model": self._agent.model,
255             "messages": self._agent.messages,
256             "system_prompt": self._agent.system_prompt,
257         }
258 
259         try:
260             tool_events = self._agent.tool_executor._stream(
261                 self._agent,
262                 tool_use,
263                 tool_results,
264                 invocation_state,
265                 structured_output_context=None,
266             )
267 
268             async for tool_event in tool_events:
269                 if isinstance(tool_event, ToolInterruptEvent):
270                     self._agent._interrupt_state.deactivate()
271                     interrupt_names = [interrupt.name for interrupt in tool_event.interrupts]
272                     raise RuntimeError(f"interrupts={interrupt_names} | tool interrupts are not supported in bidi")
273 
274                 await self._event_queue.put(tool_event)
275 
276             # Normal flow for all tools (including stop_conversation)
277             tool_result_event = cast(ToolResultEvent, tool_event)
278 
279             tool_use_message: Message = {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"toolUse": tool_use}]}
280             tool_result_message: Message = {"role": "user", "content": [{"toolResult": tool_result_event.tool_result}]}
281             await self._agent._append_messages(tool_use_message, tool_result_message)
282 
283             await self._event_queue.put(ToolResultMessageEvent(tool_result_message))
284 
285             # Check for stop_conversation before sending to model
286             if tool_use["name"] == "stop_conversation":
287                 logger.info("tool_name=<%s> | conversation stop requested, skipping model send", tool_use["name"])
288                 connection_id = getattr(self._agent.model, "_connection_id", "unknown")
289                 await self._event_queue.put(
290                     BidiConnectionCloseEvent(connection_id=connection_id, reason="user_request")
291                 )
292                 return  # Skip the model send
293 
294             # Send result to model (all tools except stop_conversation)
295             await self.send(tool_result_event)
296 
297         except Exception as error:
298             await self._event_queue.put(error)
